q1.explanationZh: wind“风”加 -y 构成形容词 windy“多风的；风大的”。

q2.explanationZh: wine 名词“酒；葡萄酒”，注意与 wing“翅膀”区分。

q3.explanationZh: wing 名词“翅膀；翼”，结尾是 -ng。

q4.explanationZh: win 加 -er 构成 winner“获胜者”，要双写 n。

q5.explanationZh: winter 名词“冬季”，in winter“在冬天”。

q6.explanationZh: wipe 及物动词“擦；抹”，如 wipe the dishes“擦碟子”。

q7.explanationZh: wire 名词“电线；金属丝”，wireless 就是“无线的”。

q8.explanationZh: wisdom 是 wise 的名词形式“智慧”，注意拼写 wis-dom，没有 e。

q9.explanationZh: wise 形容词“有智慧的；聪明的”，名词是 wisdom。

q10.explanationZh: wish 可作动词和名词，表示“祝愿；希望”。

q11.explanationZh: wit 名词“风趣；智力”，只有三个字母。

q12.explanationZh: with 介词“和……一起；用；带有”。

q13.explanationZh: withdraw = with + draw，“抽回，收回；撤退”，过去式 withdrew。

q14.explanationZh: within 介词“在……之内”，within an hour“一小时之内”。

q15.explanationZh: without 介词“没有”，后接名词或动名词，与 with 意思相反。

q16.explanationZh: witness 名词“目击者”，动词“目击；见证”，结尾双写 s。

q17.explanationZh: wolf“狼”，以 -f 结尾的名词复数常把 f 变成 v 再加 -es：wolf → wolves。

q18.explanationZh: woman“妇女”，复数是不规则变化 women（a 变 e）。

q19.explanationZh: wonder 作动词“想知道；感到惊讶”，作名词“奇迹”。

q20.explanationZh: wonder 加 -ful 构成形容词 wonderful“精彩的”，-ful 只有一个 l。

q21.explanationZh: wood 名词“木头；木材”，be made of wood“由木头制成”。

q22.explanationZh: wood 加 -en 构成形容词 wooden“木制的”。

q23.explanationZh: wool 名词“羊毛”，注意是双写 o。

q25.explanationZh: work 可作名词“工作；作品”，也可作动词“工作；使劳动”。

q26.explanationZh: work 加 -er 构成 worker“工人”。

q28.explanationZh: world 名词“世界”，all over the world“全世界”。

q30.explanationZh: worm 名词“虫，蠕虫”，谚语 The early bird catches the worm.

q31.explanationZh: worn 形容词“用旧的；穿旧的”，也是 wear 的过去分词。

q32.explanationZh: worry 动词“担心”，worry about sth.“担心某事”。

q33.explanationZh: worse 是 bad / badly / ill 的比较级“更坏的；更糟”。

q34.explanationZh: worst 是 bad / badly / ill 的最高级“最坏的；最糟地”。

q35.explanationZh: work out“解决；算出；制订出；弄懂”。

q36.explanationZh: be worried about“为……而担心”，worried 是形容词。

q37.explanationZh: wish (that) + 从句“但愿”，从句一般用虚拟语气，that 可以省略。

q38.explanationZh: wish for“希望得到”，多指不太容易得到的东西。

q39.explanationZh: wish sb. well“祝某人好运”，wish sb. ill“希望某人倒霉”。

q40.explanationZh: work on“继续工作；致力于；对……有影响”。

q41.explanationZh: witness 作“目击者”时后接 of 或 to：a witness of the accident。

q42.explanationZh: work at“从事于，致力于”，如 work at the problem“处理这个问题”。

q43.explanationZh: do / work wonders“创造奇迹”，wonder 作名词“奇迹”时用复数。

q44.explanationZh: no wonder (that)“难怪”，后面可直接接句子。

q45.explanationZh: wonder about sth.“对某事觉得好奇，想知道”。

q46.explanationZh: wonder at sth.“对……感到惊奇”，介词用 at。

q47.explanationZh: by word of mouth“口头地，口耳相传地”。

q48.explanationZh: have a word with sb.“和某人说话（简短交谈）”，word 用单数。

q49.explanationZh: in a word / in one word“总之，简言之”。

q50.explanationZh: “我希望我知道发生了什么事”，wish 后的从句用虚拟语气（knew）。

q51.explanationZh: 修饰名词 bridge 要用形容词 wooden“木制的”。

q52.explanationZh: “智慧比财富更珍贵”，作主语用名词 wisdom，句首大写。

q53.explanationZh: will 后用动词原形，work 作及物动词“使（肌肉）活动，锻炼”。

q54.explanationZh: “她担心自己的处境不佳”，worry that…，与从句 was 一致用过去式 worried。

q55.explanationZh: have a wonderful time“玩得很开心”，such a + 形容词 + 名词。

q56.explanationZh: witness 作动词“目击”，事故已发生，用过去式 witnessed。

q57.explanationZh: with (a) good grace“欣然地，大方地”。

q58.explanationZh: 用葡萄酿的是 wine“葡萄酒”。

q59.explanationZh: advise sb. to do，to 后用原形；withdraw“撤回（指控）”。

q60.sampleAnswer: With the flu not completely under control, many netizens are giving a thumbs-up to the humanized management of the local government.
references: With the flu not completely under control, many netizens are giving a thumbs-up to the humanized management of the local government.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: 用 with 复合结构 with + 名词 + 介词短语 / 形容词表示伴随情况：With the flu not completely under control；“点赞”= give a thumbs-up to。

q61.sampleAnswer: On a winter morning, nothing is more wonderful than drinking a cup of steaming soy milk.
references: On a winter morning, nothing is more wonderful than drinking a cup of steaming soy milk.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “没什么比……更……”用 nothing is more + 形容词 + than，比较级表达最高级意思；than 后用动名词 drinking。

q62.sampleAnswer: Keeping all the required books, pens, and other instruments within reach helps you to stay focused on studying.
references: Keeping all the required books, pens, and other instruments within reach helps you to stay focused on studying.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: 动名词短语 Keeping … within reach 作主语，谓语用单数 helps；“伸手可及”= within reach；“集中注意力”= stay focused on。

q63.sampleAnswer: Do you think it possible to learn a foreign language well without learning a single word by heart?
references: Do you think it possible to learn a foreign language well without learning a single word by heart?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: think it possible to do 中 it 是形式宾语；without 是介词，后接动名词 learning；“背”= learn … by heart。

q64.sampleAnswer: These women doctors have saved many children’s lives since they worked in the hospital.
references: These women doctors have saved many children’s lives since they worked in the hospital.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: woman 修饰复数名词时也要用复数：women doctors；since 引导的时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时。

q65.sampleAnswer: No wonder people say that those who have visited Shanghai but missed Yu Garden cannot claim that they have been to the city.
references: No wonder people say that those who have visited Shanghai but missed Yu Garden cannot claim that they have been to the city.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “难怪”= no wonder，后面直接接句子；those who … 表示“……的人”。

q66.sampleAnswer: Shanghai attracts a lot of visitors from all over the world every year.
references: Shanghai attracts a lot of visitors from all over the world every year.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “世界各地”= all over the world；每年发生的事用一般现在时，主语第三人称单数用 attracts。

q67.sampleAnswer: So long as we have enough food and fuel, we shall have nothing to worry about.
references: So long as we have enough food and fuel, we shall have nothing to worry about.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “只要”= so long as；“没什么可担心的”= have nothing to worry about，worry about 的 about 不能丢。

q68.sampleAnswer: Is the saying that we should devote our limited life to the unlimited work of serving people out of date?
references: Is the saying that we should devote our limited life to the unlimited work of serving people out of date?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: that 引导同位语从句说明 the saying；devote … to …“把……投入到……”，to 是介词，后接名词 work；“过时”= out of date。

q69.sampleAnswer: Word came that the Chinese government rented helicopters to carry out rescue operations immediately after the earthquake hit New Zealand, which made Chinese people very proud.
references: Word came that the Chinese government rented helicopters to carry out rescue operations immediately after the earthquake hit New Zealand, which made Chinese people very proud.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: word 表示“消息”时不可数、不加冠词：Word came that …“消息传来说……”；which 引导非限制性定语从句指代前面整件事。
